plan.missingModel: No model – the item uses the look of its base material.
plan.variantNeedsMainModel: Needs a main model. Import a model for the item first.
plan.variantEmpty: Has been added but does not contain a model yet.
plan.rawYamlNotMapping: Error in the additional YAML: it must consist of key-value pairs (e.g. "Mechanics: ...").
plan.packIconNotPng: The pack icon must be a PNG file.
plan.duplicateFile: The file “{path}” would be created more than once in the pack. Make the item IDs or set IDs unique.
plan.armorSetIdMissing: The set ID for the armor texture is missing.
plan.armorSetIdInvalid: The set ID “{set}” may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _ . -
plan.armorLayerNeedsVersion: Only exists from Minecraft {version} on – the project targets {target}.
plan.armorLayerAspect: The texture should be twice as wide as it is high (e.g. 64×32) but is {width}×{height}.
plan.armorLayerConflict: Uploaded several times with different textures for the set “{set}”. The first one is used.
plan.armorSetWithoutTexture: No item of the set “{set}” has an uploaded texture.
plan.armorSetElytraAndPlayer: The set “{set}” contains elytra wings and player armor – the wings would then also appear on the chestplate. Elytras need their own set ID.
plan.armorSetMobAndSaddle: The set “{set}” mixes animal armor and a saddle – use two set IDs for that.
plan.armorMaterialNoSlot: The material {material} does not define an armor slot. HEAD is used – otherwise add the “Equippable” component with the right slot.
plan.namespaceInvalid: The namespace “{namespace}” may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _ . -
plan.namespaceMinecraft: The namespace “minecraft” would overwrite vanilla files. Choose a namespace of your own.
plan.namespaceNexo: The namespace “nexo” is also used by Nexo itself. A namespace of your own avoids conflicts.
plan.packNameInvalid: The pack name “{name}” may only contain letters, digits and _ . -
plan.folderSlugClash: The folders “{first}” and “{second}” result in the same folder name “{slug}”. Rename one of them.
plan.folderEmpty: The folder “{folder}” is empty and is not exported.
plan.itemIdInvalid: The item ID “{id}” may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _.
plan.itemIdDuplicate: The item ID “{id}” is already used by “{other}”. Item IDs must be unique.
plan.modelNeedsVersion: The model needs at least Minecraft {version} (e.g. because of free rotations), but the project targets {target}.
plan.textureRefUndefined: Texture “{key}” refers to “{value}”, which is not defined in the model.
plan.textureRefForeign: Texture “{key}” refers to “{value}”, which is not part of this pack.
plan.faceTextureUndefined: Faces use the texture “#{key}”, which is not defined (shown purple/black).
plan.materialInvalid: The material “{material}” is invalid (UPPERCASE letters, digits and _ only).
plan.propertyNeedsVersion: Needs Minecraft {version} or newer and is ignored on {target}.
plan.fieldNotANumber: “{value}” is not a number – it is left out of the export.
plan.fieldNotABoolean: “{value}” is neither true nor false – it is left out of the export.
plan.fieldNotAnOption: “{value}” is not one of the possible values.
plan.fieldInvalidValue: The value has the wrong type – it is left out of the export.
plan.blockTypeMissing: The custom block has no block type.
plan.blockVariationDuplicate: The variation {variation} ({type}) is already used by “{other}”.
plan.blockWithoutModel: The block has no model. Import a model or enter a path in the “Model” field.
plan.damageableStackable: Items with durability (max_damage) must not be stackable – set the stack size to 1.
plan.extraModelsNeedMainModel: GUI Model, furniture models and Stackable need a main model. Import a model first.
plan.furnitureMechanicMissing: Furniture models are uploaded, but the “Furniture” mechanic is missing – they are not exported.
plan.connectableNeedsVersion: Connectable with custom models needs at least Minecraft {version}.
plan.connectableIncomplete: Connectable: {missing} of {total} models are missing – the main model is shown there.
plan.connectableTypeOverridden: Connectable is set to “{type}” – ITEM_MODEL is used for the uploaded models.
plan.guiModelNeedsVersion: A GUI Model needs at least Minecraft {version} (item models).
plan.guiModelDisablesVariants: With a GUI Model or connectable models, {variants} no longer take effect.
plan.furnitureModelsNeedVersion: Custom furniture models need at least Minecraft {version}.
plan.stateMissing: A model is uploaded for the state “{state}”, but the state no longer exists – the model is not exported.
plan.stateTypeUnused: State “{state}” is of type {type} – the uploaded model is not used for it.
plan.customBlockMechanicMissing: Stackable models are uploaded, but the “Custom Block” mechanic is missing – they are not exported.
plan.stackableNeedsStringblock: Stackable only works with the block type STRINGBLOCK.
plan.fileUnreadable: The file “{path}” could not be read and is left out.
plan.unsafePath: The path “{path}” would leave its folder and is not exported.

selection.packNameClash: “{first}” and “{second}” use the same pack name “{pack}”. Rename it in the settings of one of the projects.
selection.itemIdClash: The item ID “{id}” exists in “{first}” and in “{second}”. Item IDs must be unique.
selection.glyphIdClash: The glyph “{id}” exists in “{first}” and in “{second}”. Glyph IDs must be unique.
selection.soundIdClash: The sound “{id}” exists in “{first}” and in “{second}”. Sound IDs must be unique.
selection.paintingIdClash: The painting “{id}” exists in “{first}” and in “{second}”. Painting IDs must be unique.
selection.pluginFileClash: “{first}” and “{second}” would both write the file “{path}” (same project name “{slug}”). Rename one of the projects.
selection.assetFileClash: “{first}” and “{second}” both contain “{path}” – only one file wins in the finished pack. A namespace of its own per project avoids this.

model.invalidBbmodel: “{file}” is not a valid .bbmodel file (JSON error: {error}).
model.noBlockbenchModel: “{file}” does not contain a Blockbench model.
model.nonJavaFormat: The model uses the Blockbench format “{format}” instead of “Java Block/Item”. Cubes are converted; group rotations, meshes and animations are lost. For an exact result, convert the model to “Java Block/Item” in Blockbench via “File → Convert Project”.
model.textureNotPng: The texture “{name}” is not a PNG. Minecraft only supports PNG textures.
model.skippedNonCubes: {count, plural, one {# element is not a cube (e.g. a mesh) and cannot be exported in Java format. It was skipped.} other {# elements are not cubes (e.g. meshes) and cannot be exported in Java format. They were skipped.}}
model.facesWithoutTexture: {count, plural, one {# face has} other {# faces have}} no texture and will be shown purple/black in Minecraft. Assign a texture in Blockbench or disable the face.
model.invalidUvRotation: {count, plural, one {# face has} other {# faces have}} a UV rotation that is not a multiple of 90°.
model.rotatedGroups: The model contains rotated groups. These rotations are not carried over to the Java format.
model.requiresVersion: The model uses rotations/features that need at least Minecraft {version}.
model.textureNotEmbedded: The texture “{name}” is not embedded in the .bbmodel file. Drop the PNG file as well or assign it in the Model tab.
model.unusedTextures: {count, plural, one {# unused texture was} other {# unused textures were}} not imported.
model.noExportableCubes: The model contains no exportable cubes.
model.notMinecraftModelEmpty: “{file}” is not a Minecraft model (it has neither "elements", "parent" nor "textures").
model.overridesRemoved: The "overrides" section (old CustomModelData method) was removed – Nexo creates the item mapping itself.
model.fileNotPng: “{file}” is not a PNG. Minecraft only supports PNG textures.
model.textureAutoAssigned: “{file}” was automatically assigned to the texture “{ref}”.
model.vanillaTexture: Texture “{keys}” refers to the vanilla texture “{ref}” and is kept as is.
model.texturePngMissing: No PNG was found for the texture “{keys}” (“{ref}”). Drop the matching PNG or assign it in the Model tab.
model.unusedPng: “{file}” is not used by the model and was ignored.
model.notInParentChain: “{file}” is not part of the parent chain of the model “{model}” and was ignored.
model.parentsMerged: {count, plural, one {# parent model was} other {# parent models were}} merged into the model.
model.invalidElements: {count, plural, one {# element has} other {# elements have}} invalid "from"/"to" values.
model.elementsOutOfBounds: {count, plural, one {# element lies} other {# elements lie}} outside the allowed range of -16 to 32. Minecraft does not load such models. Scale the model down (e.g. via the display scale in Blockbench) or move it.
model.customParent: The model uses the parent model “{parent}”. It must be in the pack as well – ideally drop the parent JSON too.
model.vanillaParent: The parent model “{parent}” is taken from Minecraft.
model.tooManyLayers: Minecraft supports at most {max} layers – “{file}” is ignored.
model.pngUnassigned: “{file}” was not assigned to a texture key and is ignored.
model.conversionFailed: The model could not be converted: {error}

texture.missing: The texture “{name}” is missing. Assign a PNG file.
texture.animationSizeMismatch: The animation of the texture “{name}” does not match the image size ({width}×{height}, frame {frameWidth}×{frameHeight}).
texture.maybeAnimation: “{name}” is {width}×{height}. If it is an animation, enable the animation in the Model tab.
texture.notPowerOfTwo: “{name}” ({width}×{height}) does not have a power-of-two size. That works, but can make the mipmaps in game look worse.

sync.otherProjectInFolder: This folder contains a different shared project.

file.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON: {error}
file.unexpectedContent: The file does not have the expected content.

recipe.resultAmountRange: The result amount must be between 1 and 99.
recipe.gridEmpty: There is no ingredient in the grid yet.
recipe.cookingTimeInvalid: The cooking time must be at least 1 tick.
recipe.experienceNegative: The experience must not be negative.
recipe.materialInvalid: “{id}” is not a valid Minecraft item name (e.g. DIAMOND).
recipe.tagInvalid: “{id}” is not a valid tag (e.g. planks).
recipe.nexoItemNotInProject: The Nexo item “{id}” is not in this project – it must exist on the server.
recipe.ceItemNotInProject: The item “{id}” is not in this project. CraftEngine skips the recipe unless another pack on the server has it.
recipe.amountRange: The amount must be between 1 and 64.

glyph.idInvalid: The ID may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _.
glyph.idDuplicate: This ID is already used by another glyph.
glyph.placeholderShared: The placeholder “{placeholder}” is also used by “{owner}”.
glyph.referenceMissing: No glyph to refer to is specified.
glyph.referenceNotInProject: The glyph “{reference}” is not in this project – it must exist on the server.
glyph.referenceNotMultiBitmap: “{reference}” is not a multi-bitmap glyph (rows × columns > 1).
glyph.indexRange: The index must be between 1 and {max}.
glyph.gifMissing: No GIF file has been uploaded yet.
glyph.pngMissing: No PNG texture has been uploaded yet.
glyph.heightInvalid: The height must be a whole number of at least 1.
glyph.ascentNotInteger: Ascent must be a whole number.
glyph.ascentTooLarge: Ascent ({ascent}) must not be greater than the height ({height}).
glyph.gridUneven: The image ({width}×{height}) cannot be split evenly into {rows} row(s) × {columns} column(s).
glyph.cellTooLarge: A glyph cell is {width}×{height} (at most {max}×{max}). Scale the image down or split it into rows/columns.
glyph.fontInvalid: The font must look like namespace:name.
glyph.animatedShaders: Animated glyphs use core shaders and may break with Minecraft updates.

sound.idInvalid: The name may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _ . - (e.g. block.ruby.place).
sound.idDuplicate: Another sound already has this name.
sound.fileMissing: No OGG file has been uploaded yet.
sound.notOgg: “{file}” is not an OGG file. Minecraft only plays .ogg (Vorbis).
sound.volumeRange: The volume should be between 0 and 1 (more than 1 only increases the range).
sound.jukeboxDurationMissing: The music disc is missing the length of the song (e.g. 2m 30s or 150s).
sound.comparatorRange: The comparator signal must be between 0 and 15.
sound.streamLongSongs: Better “stream” long songs – then Minecraft does not load them into memory completely.

painting.datapackNeedsVersion: Nexo only creates the datapack for custom paintings from Minecraft 1.21.5 on – for older versions you have to create it yourself.
painting.idInvalid: The ID may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _.
painting.idDuplicate: Another painting already has this ID.
painting.widthRange: The width must be between 1 and 16 blocks.
painting.heightRange: The height must be between 1 and 16 blocks.
painting.imageMissing: No image (PNG) has been uploaded yet.
painting.animationFrames: For an animation, several images with the aspect ratio {width}:{height} must be stacked vertically.
painting.aspectMismatch: The image ({imageWidth}×{imageHeight}) does not match the aspect ratio of {width}×{height} blocks – it will be distorted.

project.invalidFile: The file is not a valid ResourcepackBuilder project file.
project.notProjectFile: The file is not a ResourcepackBuilder project file.

yaml.duplicateKey: The key in line {line} appears twice ({detail}).

ce.itemIdInvalid: The item ID “{id}” is invalid (lowercase letters, digits and _ only).
ce.missingModel: No model: CraftEngine shows the item with the look of its base material. Import a model or set model or texture in the additional YAML.
ce.variantUnsupported: CraftEngine does not use this model yet, so it is not exported.
ce.variantSlotsFilled: CraftEngine needs {count} models for {material}. The missing ones show the main model.
ce.glyphGifUnsupported: CraftEngine shows only PNG images, so this animated glyph is not exported.
ce.glyphReferenceUnknown: “{reference}” is not a multi-bitmap glyph of this project. CraftEngine cannot find the cell, so this glyph is not exported.
ce.recipeKindUnsupported: CraftEngine has no recipe type for “{type}” recipes, so this recipe is not exported.
ce.materialInvalid: The material “{material}” is invalid for CraftEngine (e.g. diamond_sword or minecraft:diamond_sword).
ce.variantExtraModels: CraftEngine uses only the first {used, plural, one {model} other {# models}} of this variant. The other {count} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not exported.
ce.reservedPackName: The pack name “{name}” belongs to one of CraftEngine's own packs (default, default_…, internal). Choose another pack name in the project settings.
ce.blockStateMissing: The block has no state. Choose a block state group in the Block section of the model tab.
ce.blockAutoStateInvalid: CraftEngine has no block state group “{group}”. Choose one in the Block section of the model tab.
ce.blockMissingModel: The block has no model, so CraftEngine cannot load it. Import a model or textures on the model tab.
ce.blockExtraTextures: A block made from textures uses at most {max} of them, so {count, plural, one {one more texture is} other {# more textures are}} left out of the block.
ce.autoStateBudget: The project’s blocks need {used} block states of the group “{group}”, but CraftEngine has only {capacity}. Move some blocks to another group.
ce.blockAppearanceStateMissing: The appearance “{appearance}” has no block state. Choose a block state group for it in the Block section of the model tab.
ce.blockPropertyInvalid: The block property “{property}” is incomplete: it needs a known type, an int a range and a string its values.
ce.blockNoAppearance: The block’s states have no appearance. Add one in the Block section of the model tab.
ce.blockVariantInvalid: The variant “{variant}” names a property or value the block does not have. Write it as property=value pairs, separated by commas.
ce.blockVariantAppearanceMissing: The variant “{variant}” uses the appearance “{appearance}”, which the block does not have.
ce.blockTemplateArgumentMissing: The fence needs the item “{argument}”. Set it in the Block section of the model tab.
ce.blockBehaviorProperty: The behavior {behavior} needs the block property “{property}” of the type {type}. Add it to the block’s states.
ce.blockBaseShared: The blocks {blocks} all borrow the states of {block}, but each state can only show one of them. Choose another vanilla block for all but one.
ce.rawBlockWithoutBlock: The additional YAML has a block: section, but the item is no block, so the section is left out. Turn on “Place as a block” in the Block section of the model tab.
ce.blockFenceItemUnknown: The fence shows the item “{item}”, which the project does not have. Create it with the model of the post or the side, or choose another item in the Block section.
ce.furnitureWithBlock: The item is a block and furniture at once. CraftEngine can place only one of them, so the furniture is left out. Turn off one of them in the model tab.
ce.rawFurnitureWithoutFurniture: The additional YAML has a furniture: section, but the item is no furniture, so the section is left out. Turn on “Place as furniture” in the Furniture section of the model tab.
ce.furnitureNoVariant: The furniture has no variant. Add one in the Furniture section of the model tab.
ce.furnitureNoPlaceableVariant: The item cannot place the furniture: it has no ground, wall or ceiling variant.
ce.furnitureVariantEmpty: The variant “{variant}” has no elements, so the furniture is invisible there.
ce.furnitureElementTypeInvalid: An element of the variant “{variant}” has the unknown type “{type}”.
ce.furnitureElementKeyMissing: An element of the type {type} in the variant “{variant}” needs “{key}”.
ce.furnitureItemUnknown: The variant “{variant}” shows the item “{item}”, which the project does not have.
ce.furnitureValueInvalid: CraftEngine cannot read “{value}” as {key} in the variant “{variant}”.
ce.furnitureHitboxTypeInvalid: A hitbox of the variant “{variant}” has the unknown type “{type}”.
ce.furnitureRuleInvalid: The placement rule {key} of the variant “{variant}” has the unknown value “{value}”.
ce.furnitureHitboxEntityMissing: A custom hitbox of the variant “{variant}” needs an entity type (“entity_type”).
ce.blockRendererTypeInvalid: An entity renderer element of “{look}” has the unknown type “{type}”.
ce.blockRendererKeyMissing: An entity renderer element of the type {type} in “{look}” needs “{key}”.
ce.blockRendererItemUnknown: The entity renderer of “{look}” shows the item “{item}”, which the project does not have.
ce.blockRendererValueInvalid: CraftEngine cannot read “{value}” as {key} in the entity renderer of “{look}”.
ce.blockTransparentInvisible: “{look}” hides the block’s model but has no entity renderer, so the block is invisible there. Add an element to its entity renderer.
ce.rawBlockNotMapping: The additional YAML’s block: holds no key-value pairs, so it is left out. Write the block’s keys below it (e.g. behavior:).
